topArticle.title: ANC faces anger over poor services as South Africans vote in local elections

Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts
The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.
The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party. However, polls showed it getting less than a third of the vote, down from 45.6% at the last municipal elections in 2021 and 40.2% in 2024’s national elections.

topArticle.summary: エベレスト基地キャンプ付近でヘリコプター2機が着陸中に衝突し、インド人観光客1名が死亡する事故が発生しました。

topArticle.title: Wage protests force hundreds of Bangladesh garment factories to close
topArticle.description: These factories, which manufacture for brands like H&M and Uniqlo, rely on millions of lowly paid workers.
topArticle.titleJa: 賃上げ抗議によりバングラデシュの縫製工場数百が閉鎖
topArticle.summary: バングラデシュで賃上げを求める抗議活動が激化し、H&Mやユニクロなどに製品を供給する数百の縫製工場が閉鎖に追い込まれています。

topArticle.title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
topArticle.description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of Viet Nam takes place on 4 and 6 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Viet Nam.
topArticle.titleJa: 貿易政策審査：ベトナム
topArticle.summary: 2026年11月4日と6日にベトナムの貿易政策と慣行に関する第3回審査が開催されます。WTO事務局とベトナム政府の報告書が基礎となります。

topArticle.title: Cotton partners launch drive to bring textile/garment investment to West, Central Africa
topArticle.description: On the margins of the Global Aid for Trade Review, the Partenariat pour le Coton (PPC – the Cotton Partnership) launched an Investment Promotion Drive on 29 October to help Africa’s farmers move from exporting cotton as raw fibre to increasing participation in higher-value activities, such as garment manufacturing. The aim of the drive is to connect investment with on-the-ground projects that will generate jobs and economic growth.
topArticle.titleJa: 綿花パートナー、西アフリカ・中央アフリカへの繊維・衣料品投資促進活動を開始
topArticle.summary: 綿花パートナーシップは、西アフリカ・中央アフリカにおける綿花産業の高付加価値化と雇用創出を目的とした投資促進活動を開始しました。

topArticle.title: Côte d'Ivoire President: Re-globalization an opportunity to move beyond traditional trade
topArticle.description: "Re-globalization presents an opportunity for developing countries to move beyond their traditional areas of specialization in exporting primary products, and to occupy a more prominent place in the spheres of innovation, transformation, industrial production and marketing." That was the key message on 29 October of H.E. Alassane Ouattara, President of Côte d'Ivoire, who delivered the latest edition of the Presidential Lecture under the WTO’s Presidential Lecture Series.
topArticle.titleJa: コートジボワール大統領：再グローバル化は伝統的貿易を超える機会
topArticle.summary: コートジボワール大統領は、再グローバル化が途上国にとって、伝統的な一次産品輸出を超え、イノベーション分野に進出する機会であると述べました。
